implementation.discovery: ACL-independent SQL counts only missing lexical markers for ready/rebuilding chunks joined to documents with matching tenant; no-work bypasses unnecessary administrator lookup
implementation.administrator: Must be an admin membership joined to an existing workspace; production does not invent any identity or change ACL
implementation.deferred_unservable: Only absent workspace AND zero memberships; preserve original document, policy and chunk rows, and never persist an indexed/completion marker for deferred work
implementation.readiness: A second ACL-independent census blocks any remaining work unless that workspace is still strictly unservable; ready_for_currently_servable_corpus is separate from all_eligible_indexed
implementation.future_restoration: Every invocation rechecks source SQL; restoration of a workspace or membership makes remaining missing chunks block until a valid administrator completes indexing
implementation.request_boundary: backend/services/lexical_retrieval.py and per-request ACL behavior unchanged
implementation.migration_failure: Report actual child exit code and /data/lexical-backfill.json location without copying captured driver stdout/stderr
